column_description: text. Unique shipment record key. PK. Example: CC381686.
timestamp. Log-creation timestamp for this record. **NULL means record creation time not captured.**. Example: 2025-01-29T16:01:15.
text. Human-friendly shipment token (unique within system). Example: SH88875.
